W.note: Soft pastel aurora bloom with long exhale curves and good focus and reduced-motion handling, but the hover is subtle and the glow washes out on the pale page.

X.note: Vivid pink-to-cyan bloom behind a white pill label with layered 1.1-1.6s curves, drift, press snap and reduced-motion fallback; legible and clearly ethereal.

Y.note: Dark moody page where a peach-lilac glow blooms and floats with slow exhale curves, pointer-following sheen, distinct leave timing, strong focus ring and thorough reduced-motion rules.

Z.note: Solid gradient button with a drifting white sheen on hover that is pleasant and highly legible, but it reads more polished than ethereal.
